description.full_text: The image shows a bowl filled with steamed broccoli and slices of cooked chicken, placed on a wooden surface. To the side, there is a small dish containing soy sauce with pieces of ginger. The overall mood is fresh and healthy, suggesting a simple, nutritious meal.
